sentences.text: 2. The petitioner's land was acquired under the provision of the National Highways Act.
The petitioner was not satisfied with the quantum of compensation offered to him.
He therefore filed a petition under Section 3(G)(5) of the National Highways Act.
Since the first respondent has not determined the amount, the present writ petition has been filed.

3. The first respondent is directed to pass award on the petition filed by the petitioner under Section 3(G)(5) of the Act on merits and in accordance with law within a period of eight months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
I make it clear that I have not gone into the merits of the matter.
4. The Writ Petition is disposed of accordingly.
